method: Actual built notebook cells. Every file output downloaded, independently probed and fully decoded by native FFmpeg. Each independent cell then checked in the app. Subtitle commands rerun after explicit font-family fix; independent checker visually verified original and edited cues. Raw status is preserved; ffprobe -1 is not native success zero.
